scientific_integrity: The formula is an ambient relative projection minimum over all real linear projections. Standard cut-space identification and averaging are attributed to the literature. Finite tests are not presented as infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The two edges of each branch have the same positive length; no claim is made for arbitrary unrelated edge lengths or iterated diamond graphs. Exact symbolic and numerical checks supplement an all-parameter proof, and independent scientific review has not been performed.
title: Exact cut-space projection constants of weighted multibranch diamonds
